examples: The 13 audited content questions remain accounted for in the current reconstruction.
CQ-14 accounts for full-timeline non-speech audio, bounded narrative roles, rejected labels, and attribution/rights unknowns.
The context-level audio unit is separately closed by the available-carrier and meta-gates.
The audio unit limits continuous music and three transient groups to pacing, notification association, emphasis, and closing punctuation.
It does not convert audio packaging into proof of delivery, automation completion, or commercial performance.
The repaired coarse and fine ledgers retain firstStart=0 and lastEnd=93.601.
The transient groups remain localized to 72-78, 82-86, and 92-93.601 seconds.
Independent-effect versus musical-accent attribution remains unknown.
Other separable screen, location, or inserted-source audio remains unknown.
